entries.partTitle: Firecracker MicroVM Architecture: Linux KVM, Minimalist Device Model & Sub-Second Boot Mechanics

spec.title: Firecracker MicroVM Boot & Minimalist Device Model
spec.description: Trace Linux KVM API calls, virtio device attachment, and sub-5 millisecond microVM boot mechanics.

steps.title: QEMU vs Firecracker Tradeoff
steps.description: Traditional QEMU emulates legacy hardware (PCI/ACPI); Firecracker provides minimal 4-device model in Rust.

steps.title: KVM Hypervisor API Direct Boot
steps.description: Minimalist vmlinux kernel loaded directly via /dev/kvm, bypassing firmware initialization.

steps.title: Sub-5ms Boot Execution
steps.description: MicroVM boots, configures virtio interfaces, and starts execution in 5.3 milliseconds.

steps.title: High-Density Bare-Metal Packing
steps.description: Lazy memory allocation and Extended Page Tables pack thousands of microVMs per bare-metal host.

entries.partTitle: The Firecracker Jailer: Multi-Tenant Sandboxing, cgroups, chroot & seccomp-bpf System Call Filters

spec.title: The Firecracker Jailer Multi-Tenant Sandbox
spec.description: Analyze privilege dropping, chroot isolation, cgroups resource limits, and seccomp-bpf filters.

steps.title: Multi-Tenant Threat Model
steps.description: Untrusted third-party code runs on shared bare-metal; Jailer builds multi-tier defense.

steps.title: Privilege Dropping & Chroot
steps.description: Jailer revokes root privileges to unprivileged UID/GID and locks process into isolated chroot jailroot.

steps.title: Seccomp-BPF Syscall Filter
steps.description: Linux kernel BPF filter intercepts syscalls, killing any process attempting unauthorized calls like ptrace.

steps.title: Cgroups Resource Quotas
steps.description: Hard CPU and memory bandwidth limits prevent noisy-neighbor workloads from impacting adjacent microVMs.

entries.partTitle: Lambda SnapStart & Micro-Snapshotting: Coordinated Restore at Checkpoint (CRaC) & Sub-200ms Resume

spec.title: Lambda SnapStart & CRaC Lifecycle
spec.description: Examine pre-initialization, encrypted micro-snapshots, sub-200ms restore, and CRaC lifecycle hooks.

steps.title: Managed Runtime Cold Start Penalty
steps.description: JVM class loading, dependency injection, and JIT compilation incur 6+ second initialization cold starts.

steps.title: Offline Pre-Initialization
steps.description: AWS pre-initializes function on deployment, executing static blocks and framework setup offline.

steps.title: Encrypted Micro-Snapshotting
steps.description: Firecracker captures vCPU registers and memory pages into encrypted, distributed tiered cache.

steps.title: Sub-200ms Restoration
steps.description: Upon user invocation, memory is restored directly into guest RAM, resuming execution in under 150ms.

entries.partTitle: The SnapStart Security Trap: PRNG Entropy Duplication, Connection Busting & Ephemeral Storage (/tmp)

spec.title: SnapStart Security Trap: PRNG Entropy & Socket Re-seeding
spec.description: Trace snapshot entropy cloning vulnerabilities, CRaC re-seeding guards, and database socket refreshing.

steps.title: Snapshot Cloning Trap
steps.description: Memory snapshot captures internal PRNG seeds; 1000 restored instances share the exact same random state.

steps.title: Automated Kernel Entropy Reseeding
steps.description: Linux guest kernel automatically refreshes /dev/urandom pools upon microVM restoration.

steps.title: CRaC Application Reseeding Guard
steps.description: AfterRestore() callback explicitly re-seeds custom SecureRandom instances and UUID generators.

steps.title: Stateful Socket Refresh & /tmp Hygiene
steps.description: Database connection pools reconnect cleanly in afterRestore(); ephemeral /tmp storage cleaned up.

entries.partTitle: Masterclass Synthesis: Production Firecracker MicroVM & Provisioned Concurrency Auto-Scaling Engine

spec.title: Enterprise Firecracker & Provisioned Concurrency Engine
spec.description: Comprehensive synthesis of microVM virtualization, SnapStart sub-200ms resume, and auto-scaling.

steps.title: Virtualization Spectrum Synthesis
steps.description: Complete unification of Firecracker KVM, Jailer sandboxing, SnapStart, and Provisioned Concurrency.

steps.title: Provisioned Concurrency Spillover
steps.description: Requests exceeding provisioned capacity spill into on-demand execution, triggering cold start spikes.

steps.title: Application Auto Scaling Mitigation
steps.description: Application Auto Scaling targets 70% provisioned utilization, scaling capacity proactively.

steps.title: Grade A+ Runtime Certification
steps.description: Serverless virtualization engine verified with 100% test coverage and sub-200ms restoration.
